description: The documents the signed-in customer can open for one of their companies, from the firm's document store: with no query or folder_id, its folders (Statutory Forms, Minutes Book, Correspondence, Customer Letters); with folder_id, what's in that folder; with query, files whose name holds every word, or, when no name matches, files whose text does (matched_by "contents"). Names, folders and dates only, never what a file says. Search by the name the file likely has in Malaysia: Certificate of incorporation: "S 17 - Certificate of Incorporation" if the company applied for one (s.17), else "S 15 - Notice of Registration", which is conclusive evidence of registration (s.19); "Form 9" for a company incorporated before 2017. Superform (registration application): "S 14 - Superform". Constitution: "Constitution"; "Memorandum and Articles" or "M&A" for an older company. Return of allotment of shares: "S 78"; "Form 24" before 2017. Change of directors or secretary: "S 58"; "Form 49" before 2017. Change of registered address: "S 46"; "Form 44" before 2017. Annual return: "S 68" or "Annual Return"; "Form 50" before 2017. Beneficial ownership (e-BOS): "S 60B" or "e-BOS". Try the likeliest name first, then the next; if nothing matches, list Statutory Forms and choose by name. create_document_link gives the customer a link to open one.

query.description: Words in the file's name, e.g. "superform" or "notice registration".

name: find_company_documents
title: Find a company's documents
